This '''unnamed Shadow Guard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]]. He was stationed at the [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|Skyhook]] at Kashyyyk. He was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] apprentice [[Galen Marek]] when he [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|stormed]] the facility and dueled the guard.

==Biography==
At some point, he became a member of the [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]], an elite subdivision of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], he was stationed at the [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|Skyhook]] on the forested [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. He then, upon learning of several Wookiees breaking free from their captivity, exited the premises to confront [[Galen Marek]], the secret apprentice of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], after discovering [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|infiltrated the facility]] to rescue both the Wookiee captives and Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] mowing down the garrison of [[Imperial Navy commando]]s, [[Imperial Heavy Trooper/Legends|Imperial heavy troopers]], [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]], and [[Imperial medic/Legends|Imperial medics]]. The two engaged in a duel. Marek won, and proceeded to run the guard with his lightsaber.

==Powers and abilities==
As a Shadow Guard, he was proficient with a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]], using it in the duel. The guardsmen also was able to use the Force to some extent, producing purple [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and able to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|Force choke]]. In the end, his skills were no match for that of Marek's.
